description: Scope-policy boundaries. With a configured default scope, omitting the scope succeeds (the default is applied) and issues a code. Naming an unsupported scope is redirected with invalid_scope / 'An unsupported scope was requested'. Naming a supported subset of a multi-scope policy succeeds. With identity-connect enabled, a non-identity scope ('email') not in the supported set is likewise rejected as an unsupported scope.
